q: How do we explain our carbon footprint to factory workers?
title: Explaining carbon to factory staff
short: Use what they see every day. Show that the footprint comes mostly from electricity and fuel they run, then link actions to it: switching off idle compressors, fixing air leaks, closing furnace doors. Put one monthly number on the notice board, kWh or litres per unit, rather than tonnes of CO2.

ul: Every hour a machine runs idle costs power and adds carbon.
A leak you can hear wastes compressed air all shift.
Logging fuel correctly keeps our buyer numbers right.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
